purpose: Extended-budget run of the v8 winner combination (16-frame blocks + motion-weighted + foreground-weighted flow loss) at 3x the previous budget on Jin's directive (2026-08-23). Fresh 300k cosine run, not a resume. Questions: does structure hold below the real floor without motion decay at 3x budget; do the residual gaps (height variance .028 vs real .061, angle jerk 1.6x) close with training alone. Predeclared n=64 milestone evaluations at 10k/20k/40k/100k/150k/200k/250k/300k.

frozen_model.backbone: full spatiotemporal DiT with signed local temporal and spatial 3D RoPE
frozen_model.teacher_forcing: clean ground-truth history during training; generated history during rollout

validation.claim_limit: Single-seed combined-treatment run; attribution of any gain to individual components rests on the matched 2k pilots, not on this run.
